M-plicits: Neural Implicit Surfaces via Nested Multiscale Residuals

An arXiv cs.CV research paper titled “M-plicits: Neural Implicit Surfaces via Nested Multiscale Residuals” was posted on 28 September 2026; the supplied record does not identify its authors. The record identifies neural implicit surfaces constructed via nested multiscale residuals, but provides no architecture, training procedure, measurements, or comparison details. No experiments, models, datasets, tests, or quantitative results are available in the supplied evidence. The record therefore establishes a publication title and topic, not a demonstrated method or performance result; independent verification and the paper’s technical contents are unavailable.
